text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As I'm walking down the hall, I hear<n>Grass
Wonder's voice coming from<n>the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the medicine. I will take<n>my leave
now.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No, I'm fine. Just a little headache,<n>it's no big—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Dear me. It seems this<n>medicine might take a
while to kick in.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder seems to be having<n>trouble with
headaches. It may be a<n>good idea to take it easy on
her for a<n>little while.
